items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: But the fellow who had the band, he was a former trombone player with Jimmy Lunceford. He was a Mexican fellow called Raymond Toya.

ctx.x: Oh, yes, just about 18. But the fellow who had the band, he was a former trombone player with Jimmy Lunceford. He was a Mexican fellow called Raymond Toya.
